title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- CONTINUOUS NEGATIVITY

content.rendered: “And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,” (Luke 8: 43)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.Our Focal Scripture introduces the woman having an issue of blood. Luke, being a doctor, used the word ‘having’ to describe the condition of that woman. The word ‘having’ is in present continuous tense. So that woman’s condition was a present, yet continuous problem. It was a problem that crossed over from one day to another and from one year to another. It was a continuous negativity.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: every continuous negativity in your life expires now. Every challenge that has lingered in your life expires now; every negativity that has been carried over from previous days, weeks, months and years, I command them to expire by the word of the Lord; every negativity that has survived your prayers again and again, I command it to end now; I command every continuous negativity to cease.People who saw that woman in the first year of her challenge would have seen her years later, and they would see the same thing they saw in the past. So, that woman had a challenge that caused her yesterday and today and even tomorrow to look exactly the same. Every power of hell that wants your tomorrow to look exactly as your yesterday, I command it to expire now. I command your tomorrow to break free from yesterday’s negativity.I proclaim the healing of God upon every area of your life that has been afflicted by continuous negativity. I proclaim the healing of God upon every part of your life that has been disfigured or distorted on account of negativity that you did not invite to yourself; I proclaim healing for that continuous health challenge; I proclaim healing for that career, business, health, finances, etc that has been stuck in continuous negativity.The negativity you saw yesterday will not continue. The end of your continuous negativity has come.Nahum 1: 9 says: “What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.”Declare With Me: No more continuous negativity, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
